subject: Isolated POC — additional compliance time & credits needed
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@novushealth.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jim Park <jim.park@novushealth.ai>
Date: 2028-05-03T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Isolated POC — additional compliance time & credits needed

Hi Monica / Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Our security & privacy team ran through the Redwood isolation design (VPC + private control plane + Okta SSO) and flagged two items that will delay our go/no-go by ~4 weeks: one additional round of penetration testing and an internal legal review of the data handling amendment.

Because these are gating items for the hospital pilot, we’re asking whether Redwood can extend the trial credits for the isolated POC by an extra 6 weeks (same topology, isolated VPC) and add a small promotional credit pool so we can run the pen-test workload without hitting the token cap.

Requested: 6-week extension + extra credit allowance (~$6k compute estimate)
Constraints: Okta SSO must be enforced; we need exportable audit logs for 90 days; SOC2 evidence pack or equivalent artifacts for our compliance team.

If you can provision those and confirm the evidence cadence, we’ll fast-track legal and IT. Appreciate any expedited path — our pilot schedule depends on it.

Best,
Elena Ramos
Head of Engineering Programs
NovusHealth

Attachments: none (will share internal checklist separately)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@novushealth.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jim Park <jim.park@novushealth.ai>
Date: 2028-05-03T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated POC — additional compliance time & credits needed

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can support an extension and a promotional credit allocation, but I need to confirm two things internally first:

1) Security sign-off on the pen-test window & audit log retention (Jonas, can you confirm the 90-day export is fine?),
2) Finance approval for the $6k compute top-up and whether that can be handled as a credit vs an invoice amendment (Karthik / Aditya).

If both are green, we’ll prepare a short amendment (DocuSign) and a temporary credit grant tied to the POC deal id. I’ll loop in security & finance now.

Next actions: I’ll ping you within 24 hours with status and the amendment link.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Team — quick economics note: the requested 6-week extension + pen-test run is roughly $5k–$7k in incremental GPU spend based on their projected sample size. Finance can approve up to $7k as a promotional credit for a strategic pilot if security signs off and Sales/SE confirm the SOW update.

Jonas — can you confirm the artifacts Novus needs (SOC2 pack vs the specific log exports)? If we can provide a scoped evidence bundle (SOC2 excerpts, configuration screenshots, and an exportable audit log CSV) that should satisfy the compliance reviewers without exposing operational detail.

If security is comfortable, I’ll ask Finance to issue a time-limited credit tied to deal NH-POC-2028-04 and put the amendment on DocuSign.

Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Isolated POC — additional compliance time & credits needed

Karthik / Monica — OK from Security with conditions. We can provide the following as a scoped evidence bundle:

- SOC2 summary extract (trust services + controls mapping)
- Okta SSO configuration checklist and integration guide (customer-managed IdP enforcement)
- Audit log export (CSV) for 90 days: includes request id, user/subject, model, timestamp, token usage (no raw data payloads)
- Pen-test coordination window (we require a scheduled window and a DoS safeguard plan)

Conditions: the credit and extension must be tied to the specific VM/pool IDs used for the POC (so we can restrict access), and we require a signed amendment that includes a clause covering pen-test rules and responsible disclosure.

If those conditions are accepted, Security signs off and I’ll provide the artifacts within 48 hours of request. For the audit log export, we’ll need a signed NDA addendum plus the amendment that Monica will send.

Jonas Weber
Security Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Approval: 6-week POC extension + promotional credit (NH-POC-2028-04)

Elena — good news. Finance has approved a time-limited promotional credit top-up of $6,500 for the isolated POC (deal NH-POC-2028-04). Per Security notes, the grant is conditional on the amendment and the NDA addendum.

What we are delivering now:
- 6-week extension on the isolated VPC topology (same pool IDs)
- $6,500 credit applied to the POC billing account (expires 2028-07-15)
- Security evidence bundle delivery plan (Jonas will deliver SOC2 extract + Okta checklist + audit-export instructions within 48 hours once the amendment is signed)

Action items for Novus:
1) Please sign the DocuSign amendment (link below) — it includes the pen-test scheduling clause and the NDA addendum for audit extracts.
2) Confirm the preferred pen-test window dates and point-of-contact for the export request.

DocuSign amendment: https://docusign.com/modify/NH-POC-Amendment-123
Attached: POC_SOW_v1.pdf, security_evidence_checklist.xlsx, amendment-docusign-link.txt

If you sign by EOD Friday we’ll schedule the evidence pull and enable the credit immediately.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Novus into pilot.

— Monica
